scope: Read-only native Source observation in a fresh authenticated panel with the existing D22 Save checkpoint
observation: The runner now checks whether the known Capture no-workspace alert appears before organization selection, whether it retires after the approved organization is selected through the UI, and whether the public capture's enabled Save target has a hit-tested interior point. It records only categorical results and safe pointer geometry, not organization names or raw notice text.
acceptance_boundary: D23 read-only acceptance is observed only if the initial notice was seen, the same notice is absent after selection, and the later Save pointer is hit-testable. If the initial notice does not appear naturally, the original native reproduction remains unverified even if later checks succeed.
write_boundary: An existing private D22 Save-attempt checkpoint is required. The recovery path may capture the approved public fixture locally but sends no Save input, never resets the checkpoint, and never retries the ambiguous prior Save.
verification: Source change awaits independent review and a root-owned guarded native run. This lane has not launched a browser, build, or test.
